answer_2.quote: We report surface textual similarity using traditional metrics like ROUGE-L F1 and recent ones like BERTScore F1. ... we also use several metrics to measure the factuality of answers, ... We design a novel LLM-based (GPT-4) evaluation metric which we call Fact-QA

answer_3.quote: We design a novel LLM-based (GPT-4) evaluation metric which we call Fact-QA, inspired by FActScore, to evaluate the factuality of predicted answers.
methods: atomic fact extraction and verification against reference

answer_4.quote: We (the authors) perform a human evaluation to examine the factual similarity between the expert annotator-written answers and the annotator-written ground-truth answers, on 5% of the test set.
answer_4.guideline: For precision, we assess if the factual information contained in the predicted answer is supported by the ground-truth answer. For recall, we assess if the factual information contained in the ground-truth answer is supported by the predicted answer.
